title: Private payrolls rose by 98,000 in June, less than expected, ADP reports
summary: ADP's June National Employment Report showed the private sector added 98,000 jobs vs. the 118,000 consensus estimate. Services contributed 96,000; leisure & hospitality added only 2,000 — weakest print of 2026 — signaling softening consumer spending ahead of the official June NFP release on July 2.
why: 低于预期就业数据加大美联储政策不确定性；隐含波动率短期或升，对 sell put 既是权利金机会也是方向风险，需结合 NFP 正式数据综合判断。

title: Fed Chair Warsh at ECB Sintra Forum: Inflation Too High, Declines to Signal July Rate Move
summary: At the ECB's Sintra forum July 1, new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said prices remain 'too high' and the Fed will deliver price stability. He declined to signal the July 28-29 FOMC outcome. Nine of 19 FOMC members now project rate hikes this year; markets are pricing a September increase from 3.50-3.75%.
why: Warsh 鹰派基调令市场重新定价9月加息预期（FOMC中位数升至3.8%），成长股估值承压；若加息落地，高市盈率科技/消费股期权定价体系需重新校准。

title: US Stocks Lower July 2: S&P 500 -0.6%, Nasdaq -1.5% as Chip Stocks Lead Retreat
summary: U.S. equities declined at the July 2 open: Nasdaq ~-1.5%, S&P 500 ~-0.6%. Semiconductor stocks led losses — Nvidia -3%, Micron -8%, SanDisk -10%. Meta surged ~8% on its new AI cloud plan. Weak ADP data, Fed Warsh's hawkish ECB remarks, and geopolitical uncertainty weighed on sentiment.
why: 科技/芯片整体承压，期权 IV 走高，为短期 sell put 提供更高权利金，但方向性下行风险同步上升；Meta 逆势大涨揭示市场重新定义 AI 变现路径，提醒关注持仓中非云端 AI 基础设施标的的估值逻辑。

title: Meta shares surge on report of new AI cloud business
summary: Meta Platforms jumped 8-10% on July 1 after reports it plans to monetize excess AI compute by launching a cloud business, competing with AWS, Azure, and GCP. Trading volume hit 159% above the 3-month average. The move aims to generate new revenue from billions in AI capex already deployed.
why: Meta 云业务新变现路径化解投资者对 AI 资本支出回报的担忧，是正面估值催化剂；同时加剧对 CoreWeave、Nebius 等纯算力商的竞争，也令 Nvidia 数据中心增量预期更复杂。

title: Google to Pay $1.97B to Klarna's PriceRunner in Swedish Antitrust Case
summary: Stockholm's Patent and Market Court on July 1 ordered Alphabet to pay 14.3 billion Swedish kronor (~$1.97B / EUR 1.3B) to Klarna-owned PriceRunner, ruling Google illegally favored its own price-comparison service over rivals. Google said it will review and likely appeal.
why: 谷歌又一欧洲反垄断重大赔偿落地，短期压制 GOOGL 情绪；搜索广告业务监管压力持续累积，若上诉失败将实际支付约20亿美元，影响财务预期。

title: Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron sued over alleged DRAM price fixing amid record memory costs
summary: A California class action (filed June 25, Sherman Act) accuses the three companies — ~90% of global DRAM supply — of coordinating a shift from DDR3/DDR4 to HBM as cover to restrict supply, causing DRAM prices to rise 700% over four years. 17 plaintiffs filed in the Northern District of California.
why: 这是本周内存股集体暴跌的核心催化剂；SK海力士（港股ETF 7709.HK）、美光（MU）、闪迪（SNDK）均直接受影响；若败诉将面临赔偿+定价权丧失双重冲击，需评估相关期权仓位的额外下行风险。

title: Palantir Just Secured the U.S. Army's Biggest Data Overhaul
summary: On July 1, Palantir (PLTR) was selected as cloud data layer for the U.S. Army's top-priority NGC2 modernization program, and announced a sovereign AI partnership with NVIDIA to deploy Nemotron open models on AIP/Foundry/Apollo for U.S. government agencies. PLTR rose ~2.8-6.8%.
why: 双催化剂（军方 NGC2 合同 + Nvidia 主权 AI 合作）强化 Palantir 国防 AI 护城河；壁垒高、竞争者难复制；sell put 持仓者关注股价是否企稳行权价上方，Nvidia 合作也验证 AIP 平台的生态扩展能力。

title: Circle (CRCL) tumbles as Stripe, Coinbase and BlackRock back rival stablecoin network
summary: Open Standard — backed by Visa, Mastercard, Stripe, Coinbase, and BlackRock — launched Open USD (OUSD) on June 30, a coalition stablecoin that redistributes reserve yield to 140+ partners instead of the issuer. This directly threatens Circle's core revenue model; CRCL fell ~17% to ~$62.
why: OUSD 把储备国债利息分给合作伙伴，从根本颠覆 Circle 赚利差的商业模式（USDC ~$74B储备）；若大型机构迁移储量，营收面临系统性下滑；与今早 Fed 稳定币监管新规（已在 data）叠加，双重压力须重新评估止损位。

title: Alibaba Sues US Defense Department Over Pentagon Blacklist Designation
summary: Alibaba filed suit in California federal court on June 23 to be removed from the Pentagon's Chinese military company list (added June 9 along with BYD and Baidu). The designation complicates U.S. capital market access and government business, though it does not trigger automatic sanctions.
why: 阿里被列为军事企业复杂化其在美资本市场运营；起诉是积极抗争信号，但胜诉时间线不明；与此前 Pentagon 5月将188家中企加入名单的趋势一致，是 BABA/9988.HK 中期持有风险因素，需跟踪诉讼进展。
